title: Rearrange String to Avoid Character Pair
summary: Rearrange all characters of s so every occurrence of y precedes every occurrence of x. Return any permutation satisfying this; other characters are unrestricted. This global ordering is stronger than merely avoiding an adjacent pair.
officialConstraints: Lowercase s length1..100; x and y are distinct lowercase letters.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
